name: UController.newOrganization adopts another organization's Reputation
summary: DAOstack's shared UController.newOrganization(avatar) was permissionless and adopted whatever Reputation the given avatar reported, making the caller a full-permission scheme. The attacker registered a fake avatar reporting Genesis Alpha's Reputation, minted a REP majority, voted itself in as a scheme on the real avatar, and had the UController send its ETH.
notes: The reset is Genesis Alpha's registration of SchemeRegistrar and GenesisProtocol as schemes on its avatar, the last setup change the exploit path needed (later than the UController deployment and the Reputation's transfer to it); UController bytecode is unverified, behaviour is from the trace.
The copycat used the same newOrganization path with its own fake avatar and took the avatar's leftover GEN and WETH dust; GEN is valued at the ETH the copycat realised selling it.
